Dreepy

Dragon Ghost

Galar · Generation 8

Dreepy is a Dragon/Ghost-type Lingering Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 0.5 m tall and weighs 2 kg. It evolves into Drakloak. Its highest base stat is Speed (82), with a base stat total of 270.
